description.p: Canopy is a keyboard-driven file manager for the desktop. It shows a folder as a list, a grid or a chain of columns, in tabs and in two panes side by side, and it previews what is selected without opening anything.

ul.li: Copy, move, rename and trash, with progress, pause and undo of each
Previews of images, video, PDFs, audio with a waveform, and source with highlighting
Search by name across indexed folders, saved as folders of their own
Archives opened and browsed a level at a time, packed and unpacked in place
Duplicate files found by content rather than by name
Tags, bookmarks, git status marks and a command palette over every command
